first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4%. Memory_91 demonstrated that in-product activation messaging improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful actions—a direct lever for the current activation decline. Memory_86 showed onboarding shortening lifted adoption, so combined messaging + streamlined flows could address both metrics simultaneously. Memory_31 will be verified to confirm the durability and mechanism of signup simplification, which may compound activation gains. Promotional_pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because memory_73 explicitly warns it reduces 30-day retention and conflicts with the primary objective of sustainable long-term revenue. Referral_incentive works only in established customers (memory_57) and won't help with current activation or onboarding gaps. Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to the SMB activation problem. A standard_experiment on activation_messaging targets the immediate QoQ decline while preserving the option to layer onboarding simplification or enterprise tactics in subsequent cycles. This approach is conservative and evidence-grounded.
